# ScopeGate

> ScopeGate is an open-source (Apache-2.0) ephemeral-credentials gateway for coding agents — Claude Code, Kimi Code, Cursor, OpenCode, and any MCP-capable harness. The agent never holds secrets; it holds short-lived, minimum-scope capabilities. Real secrets live in an AES-256-GCM encrypted local vault and are injected only at the outbound hop, so a leaked model context leaks nothing of durable value. Think of it as AWS IAM + STS for coding agents, installable by the agent itself in under 90 seconds.

## Product

- [Landing](https://scopegate.io/): What ScopeGate is, the two structural failures it fixes (secret exposure in model context, OAuth expiration mid-session), and how it works.
- [Quickstart](https://scopegate.io/docs/quickstart): Zero to first proxied tool call; fully agent-executable and non-interactive (`npm i -g scopegate && scopegate init`).
- [Security model](https://scopegate.io/docs/security-model): The enforcement rules — capability ≠ credential, write asymmetry (agents propose, humans approve), fail-closed hard limits, signed audit.
- [Agent protocol](https://scopegate.io/docs/agent-protocol): The SKILL protocol agents follow to self-operate the gateway.
- [CLI reference](https://scopegate.io/docs/cli-reference): Every `scopegate` command and flag.
- [Configuration](https://scopegate.io/docs/configuration): `scopegate.yaml`, `policies.yaml`, environment variables.

## Agent guides (self-install, self-operate)

- [Agent guides index](https://scopegate.io/docs/agents/): Who the docs are for and how to consume them.
- [01 — Quickstart: self-install](https://scopegate.io/docs/agents/01-quickstart-self-install): Detect, install and initialize ScopeGate non-interactively; the single human step (depositing secrets).
- [02 — Protocol](https://scopegate.io/docs/agents/02-protocol): The capability lifecycle — request → grant → use → expire; what `pending_human_approval` means.
- [03 — Tools reference](https://scopegate.io/docs/agents/03-tools-reference): The six `scopegate_*` MCP tools with exact parameters, return shapes and copy-paste JSON payloads.
- [04 — Connectors](https://scopegate.io/docs/agents/04-connectors): Native bridges (Huly 13 tools, Railway 7, Cloudflare 8, Google 7, GitHub App) and custom MCP upstreams.
- [05 — Policies](https://scopegate.io/docs/agents/05-policies): Capability matching, TTL rules, hard limits, and how to propose a policy a human can approve fast.
- [06 — Self-repair](https://scopegate.io/docs/agents/06-self-repair): The diagnose-first playbook for auth/connection errors.
- [07 — Security rules](https://scopegate.io/docs/agents/07-security-rules): The non-negotiables and how ScopeGate enforces them.

## Facts

- Open source, Apache-2.0. Gateway is local-first: the cloud management plane is optional and metadata-only (it never receives secret values).
- Six MCP tools: `scopegate_request_capability`, `scopegate_list_capabilities`, `scopegate_register_upstream`, `scopegate_diagnose`, `scopegate_propose_policy`, `scopegate_vault_status`.
- Token minter: gateway JWTs, GitHub App installation tokens, AWS STS, Google service-account tokens, Huly workspace tokens.
- Signed audit trail: append-only, hash-chained, Ed25519-signed JSONL; inputs are hashed, never stored.
- Fleet revocation via the cloud panel is effective in under 30 seconds on online gateways; offline agents' tokens expire by TTL anyway.
